How we use it

  1. Choose the product role and destination market.
  2. Match the formula direction to texture, fragrance and pack.
  3. Review the exact INCI, active levels, safety data and claim wording for the selected SKU.
  4. Approve the sample and project-specific documentation.

This library does not claim a fixed number of finished formulas, an exclusive formula count or a guaranteed stock list. Ask Liam for the current formula options for your selected project.
